test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Consider the given statement and decide which of the given assumptions is/are implicit in the statement.

**Statement:**

"From next month, everyone has to pay income tax no matter what your income is" - Government notice said.

**Assumptions:**

I. Government Treasury fund is getting short.

II. People of the country have become rich.

options.text: Neither I nor II is implicit.
Both I and II are implicit

solution:
Given Statement: "From next month, everyone has to pay income tax no matter what your income is" - Government notice said.

Now, 

Assumptions:

1. Government Treasury fund is getting short - Not Implicit (The statement does not provide any information regarding the state of the Government Treasury fund.)

2. People of the country have become rich - Not Implicit (The statement does not provide any information about the wealth status of the people.)

Here, Neither assumption I nor II is implicit.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
